probe.text_sample: Marie Curie | The UK’s leading end of life charity | Marie Curie Home Information Services Get involved About us Professionals 0800 090 2309 0800 090 2309 Donate Search our website Search our website Donate Open navigation menu 0800 090 2309 Give care, comfort and joy for a last Christmas Make your donation today and help provide expert care to people at the end of life and their loved ones. Donate now Donation type Single donation Monthly donation £ 23 Your gift could help pay for one hour of vital nursing care for someone living with a terminal illness in the comfort of their own home. £ 52 Your gift could help provide two hours of bereavement support by phone or webchat. £ 200 Your gift could help fund nine hours of nursing support in someone's home through the night, bringing the expert care and comfort families need. Or choose your own amount to give: £ Donate £23 Marie Curie is the UK’s leading end of life charity We bring 75 years of experience and leading research to the care we give at home, in our hospices and over the phone.
